additional_info.subject: ID0383447-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000458] Cable temp. issue CRM:00643000976
additional_info.body:
Hi Shrey,
I've checked this and found that in the PLC config, the ChargingCable was in “no cable” as such it couldn't work.
After changing this value, there are no more Error Flags, even though the frontend says Error:
Maybe for this to disappear a reboot is necessary but I don't see the need to do it if it's working fine.
Let's make sure that the outlet is indeed working and close the ticket.
Thanks and have a nice day!
Best regards,
Francisco
